description: The sensitive values found in the document, in document order. Empty when there are none.

line.description: The line number shown in brackets where the value appears.

text.description: The value, copied exactly from that line, without any label.

category.description: The category id of the value.

reason.description: One short sentence in Portuguese. Only when the confidence is incerto.

confidence.description: How sure it is that the value is sensitive.

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of the text in the line is meant. Only when it repeats.

visible.description: True only when the user's instructions ask to keep this value visible.
